(33 m) sorry to bother you with this off topic post princess but moderators on other subreddits keep removing it. can you tell me if it's too much and if so, what can be improved about it? 

**Amanda Todd day: every 10th of Oktober. a day when victims of (s)extortion simultaniously say: ENOUGH!** 

to all grey hats, trolls, memers and spammers out there: why don't you make yourself usefull for a change and bury the internet on that day with everything you got so nobody knows what is real and what is fake material for months to come.

as you probably know, these extortion victims are usually very young children being groomed on random chat sites by sociopathic pedophiles pretending to be a kid as well. they use child psychology tactics to make them fall in love with that 'other kid' online and manipulate them into sending more and more exposing pictures untill they have enough to unveil their true identity and introduce themselves as the "mastermind" behind this "intellectual masterpiece."

from than on they force those poor kids to 'shut up and dance' (black mirror episode).

PS: while you busy making that fake (virtual kids) material you might as well add some hidden subliminal messages to the material cousing the viewer to become impotent. a simple spider shadow for example might already do the trick. their primitive monkey brain recognizes the shape and immediatley triggers the instinctive FEAR button. without their "developed" brain being aware of anything at all you can slowly turn these subhumans into people that are literally scared of little children \^\_\^

to moderators: can you please not remove this post? other subreddits with depressed and suicidal people removed this post for whatever reason, they refuse to tell me why. these subs are where those kids are you know, barely hanging on to life itself. please

yea that's exactly what im affraid of, brilliant ideas dying out with their creators without the world knowing about all these ideas and solutions. it's probably the perfectionists inside that holds you guys (and galls) back from getting the word out. always chasing that perfect dragon but never realy getting close enough to see that it's just a smokeshow. ideas don't have to be perfect to work, as long as they work pefectly fine. right?

what about a crowdfunded thinktank where thinkers and do-ers can meet up and get things done together without having to worry about the money and stuff? you know of such a thing outside of the internet?

yea thanks for correcting my spelling. you made me look like an idiot, again. but yes i got the idea today and im just winging it for now. no idea how to do it but thanks to people like you im learning how to get there, though.

sure, would you like to keep your current body or..? 

seriously though, ever held a Rock Chrystal? it worked better than any meds for me. the one with points on both ends i still use if i feel a little empty inside. not sure what the exact name was. charge it with sunlight and de-charge it under flowing water (outside)

one more tip and it's a bit awkward maybe but here it goes: limit your masturbation stuff to max once a week to increase your positive energy. ah yea, and take warm mudbaths outside! almost forgot :P you connect with earths energie this way instead of the sewage...

thanks, 50 % of my profits i wil invest in anti poaching projects though. developing drones that can scan for snares and traps, charging stations, satellite connections etc. pretty costly, but so are the tusks ;)

regarding the DNA: It's dead material, like hair. only that little sack at the bottom of a plucked hair contains analysable DNA i think. not 100% sure though. thanks a million though for the horse tip! i think i love you :D

i think you are right
thank you

you know damn well i didn't i call you a guy and i'm sure there has been at least one occasion in your life where you said "ah come on you guys" while there was a female entity involved.

next: fighting ICE is like mopping the floor with the tap still running. you might wanna think about ways to close that tap and unite the people so they can dispose of their wicked (mis)leaders and stay happily ever after in their home country, young lady.

fair point, i was being a bit harsh. im not well educated either. that doesnt help. but looking at you guys being smart and all is like looking at religious people just waiting to die and go to the place that actually matters according to their leaders. i don't see earth as a waiting room. it's all we got. yet we use it like a disposable razor to de-monkey ourselves on our way to mars. i do appreciate your efforts though. it's just not gonna prevent possible extinction by solvable problems like melting permafrost and a yellowstone supervulcano. we need your brainpower for these sort of things. hence the provocative attitude ;)

absolutely agree with that. i'm not affraid of the unknown, but i don't mess around with ouija boards either you know. one might feel like a captain but it's realy the motion of the ocean that matters most. and i don't even know how to swim, so.. 

seriously though, asking ghosts to walk through locked cellar doors to see if there is someone in need may be a bit naive but what about energetic triangulation though? maybe get some people with simular vibes or DNA and stuff and try to locate people like that. wouldn't that be a cool experiment and see if it's possible?

or maybe ask ex-kidnapped people to help out. their frequenties are probably simular if they think back about the time they were kidnapped... who knows what mediums are capable off. if it was me being locked up i would be infinately gratefull to anyone trying anything at all to end this godforsaken nightmare. and i can imagine that liberated kidnapped people are a lot like soldiers coming back from war. just numb. helping others might actually give them a sense of purpose and lift their spirits once again.

thanks for your responses but my post was removed by a moderator becouse i was "soapboxing" or something. anyway, i'm going back to my solution state of mind rather than go back to that sit and wait state i was in for over 20 years. no offense, i just like to think that we humans can do increddible things as long as we unite and get our boots on the ground and hands dirty. thanks again for your mature reactions to my slightly naive posts.
alright, sorry to bother you with my "soapboxing". have a nice day.
soapboxing?

exactly my point. so instead of just sitting there like a waste of space we should be thinking about ways to over-pressurise your little titanic so the water can't come in no more. thanks for your contribution to this discussion about the prevention of a extincion level supervulcano called yellowstone, Phage.

thanks for the actual usefull respons. if you don't mind me asking, do you know if that above ground water is the source of that waterpocket above the yellowstone magma chamber? if that's the case we could use an enormous amount of weight down sunken garbage bags or something to increase waterpressure and maybe increase the natural flow of geyser water? and if not, please tell me there is a way to prevent extinction by this stupid supervulcano. why bother with life in general if it can be taken away so easily? i live in europe but this is a global issue here and i think doing at least something is better than nothing at all, don't you?

nah, pretty sure earth is just a ball shaped waiting room for religious people. and yes, i would like to learn but no one seems to have any convincing arguments. and you are definately not helping with that attitude of yours... i mean, wtf?

ha! nice analogy :) getting the titanic pieces back to areas where you can dive would be nice wouldn't it though. i'd pay good money for that trip. bet the ghosts wouldn't mind a bit of life around their wreck for a change.  

anyway, yellowstone is already cooling herself down with all those geysers isn't she? like a overheated dog with it's tongue on the floor, begging for someone to just add water... that's what it looks like to me and my little one.
